hero.description: We are Bros404. An attempt by two friends to save the world (or at least make it a bit more fun). We design modern, fast, and user-friendly applications.

whatWeDo.subtitle: Our Story
whatWeDo.desc_1: Actually, it all started with the sentence 'Wouldn't it be nice if we made an app'. As two friends, while chasing big ideas to change the world, we found ourselves developing fun and useful mobile applications.
whatWeDo.desc_2: Our goal at Bros404 is simple: to produce work that puts a smile on people's faces and makes technology enjoyable rather than complicated. We are also bored of dull corporate sites and incomprehensible menus.
whatWeDo.feature_1_desc: It's not enough that it just works, it should be read like poetry.
whatWeDo.feature_2_desc: Interactive interfaces that don't bore the user.
whatWeDo.feature_3_desc: The shortest and most effective path from idea to product.

work.title: What Have We Done?
work.subtitle: For now, Beuti is one of the products in the showcase. More will be added soon.
work.app_desc: You can explore Beuti from its product page and reach its privacy, terms, and contact information from here.
work.strong_desc: One of the products built by Bros404.

about.title: Who Are We?
about.subtitle: The brains behind Bros404. (Or at least we think so.)
about.ulvi_bio: The code machine who grabs the corner socket of the cafe table and never leaves his black terminal. Talks in database queries, draws API architectures during coffee breaks. The backend architect who builds the brain of the system, always saying 'We can write this more optimized'.
about.mert_bio: At the other end of the cafe table, the engineer who writes both the code and builds the logic of the UI. Translating complex designs into clean code, structuring the user experience with algorithmic precision. The architect of code that appeals to both the eye and the mind.
